name: diag-fe
summary: DIAGNOSTIC: VCP 0xED = connector code runs the front-end link query (0x30/7, 0x60/0xB, as the vendor standby gate) and keeps the answers at RAM 0x2024F0 for tools/poke.sh

edits.asm: fe_set (image head zero area 0x201C00): VCP 0xED -> sub_23956D(code), mailbox 0x60/0xB; results at 0x2024F0
diag-poke SET fall-through (movhi r7,0x48) -> j fe_set

notes: Results: 0x2024F0 front-end index (0x30/7 answer), 0x2024F1 link status (0x60/0xB answer), 0x2024F2 1 = the 0x60/0xB transaction completed, 0x2024F3 queried code, 0x2024F4 run counter. Codes: USB-C 8, DP 7, HDMI 1 = 1, HDMI 2 = 3. Runs only on a SET of VCP 0xED; a query the front-end does not answer can block the main loop for up to 10-20 s once. Generated by tools/patches_src_diag_fe.py.
